description: The file defines two main functions: setup and draw, which are typical in graphical or visualization scripts. It initializes a window, sets up rendering settings, and draws a sphere with specific styling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window with specified dimensions and rendering context.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles rendering each frame by setting background color, enabling orbit control, and drawing a styled sphere.
